bias.en: Rebound · back above the 10-day, under the 5-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 重回 10 日均线上方，受制于 5 日均线

read.en: Coherent rose 3.7% on Nov 17 to $210.86, trading $200.53–217.20. It is back above the 10-day ($209.7, rising) but below the 5-day ($219.8), 30-day ($234.7), 100-day ($283.7) and 200-day ($296.7). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($175.44), and RSI is 44.5.
read.zh: Coherent 11月17日上涨 3.7%，收于 $210.86，盘中区间 $200.53–217.20。股价重回 10 日均线（$209.7，上行）上方，但仍低于 5 日（$219.8）、30 日（$234.7）、100 日（$283.7）和 200 日均线（$296.7）。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$175.44），RSI 为 44.5。

read.en: The bounce reclaimed the $207–209.7 level (Nov 10 and 13 lows, 10-day), back to support, after the $200.53 low held above $195–197. Resistance is $214.7–218.2 (Nov 10 close, Nov 17 high, Nov 13 close), then $219.8–225.2 (5-day, Nov 9 close) and $232.1–234.7 (Nov 12 close, 30-day). Support is $207.1–209.7, then $200.5 (Nov 17 low) and $195.1–197.2. A close above $218.2 would target $220–225; below $207, $200.5.
